verdict.rationale: A probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at developer.intuit.com/llms.txt) and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. The only agent-oriented documentation is Intuit's official MCP server documentation page and README, which cover agent integration (sandbox setup and write-safety toggles) rather than docs built for an agent to read directly. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, agent-consumable markdown docs, and independent corroboration of agents using the docs.
